description: This file defines the ProjectActivityAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing project activities within the OrangeHRM Time module. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting project activities associated with specific projects. The class uses various traits, validators, and models to handle data operations and validation.

classes.name: ProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: API class for managing project activities, supporting CRUD operations, validation, and integration with project service and data models within the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of project activities for a specified project, optionally filtered by activity name and with pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new project activity under a specified project.

methods.name: setParamsToProjectActivity
methods.description: Sets the name and project association on a ProjectActivity entity based on request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method, including project ID and optional filtering/sorting parameters.

methods.name: getProjectIdParamRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for ensuring project ID is positive.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified project activities for a project, validating existing activity IDs and handling exceptions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete requests, including project ID and array of activity IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific project activity by project ID and activity ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single project activity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing project activity with new data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a project activity, including uniqueness validation.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Builds validation rules for request bodies during create/update operations, including ensuring name uniqueness.

methods.name: getProjectActivityCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates options to specify conditions for entity uniqueness validation, ignoring certain IDs and filtering by project and active status.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts project ID and activity ID from URL parameters for update or retrieve actions.
